headlines.title: How Dividend Growth At Linde (LIN) Has Changed Its Investment Story
headlines.summary: Linde plc recently completed two euro-denominated fixed income offerings totaling about €1.3b and reported third quarter 2026 results that showed higher sales year on year but lower quarterly net income and earnings per share. The business is restructuring its U.S. home care unit, Lincare, while still raising its dividend, which points to management prioritising both portfolio repair and consistent cash returns to shareholders.

headlines.title: Is Linde (LIN) Reasonably Priced Given Its Earnings Strength?
headlines.summary: Linde has delivered strong returns in recent years, and with the stock last closing at US$526.55, the key question now is whether that price is supported by the company’s earnings power. headlines.summary: We just published the list of Jim Cramer’s Top 10 Dividend Stocks for Safe, Consistent Returns, and Linde plc (NASDAQ:LIN) ranked 7th on this list. headlines.title: 3 Dividend Aristocrats Wall Street Analysts Like Most
headlines.summary: Decades of rising payouts earned these three stocks a place among the Dividend Aristocrats, but Wall Street's opinions on them could not be more different. One has near-unanimous praise, one has fallen hard, and one has analysts split down the middle.

description: Linde plc operates as an industrial gas company worldwide. The company offers atmospheric gases, including oxygen, nitrogen, argon, and rare gases; and process gases, such as hydrogen, helium, carbon dioxide, carbon monoxide, electronic gases, specialty gases, and acetylene. It also engages in the design and construction of turnkey process plants for third-party customers, as well as for its gas businesses, including air separation, hydrogen, synthesis, olefin, and natural gas plants. The company serves the healthcare, chemicals and energy, manufacturing, metals and mining, food and beverage, and electronics industries. It operates in the United States, Brazil, Mexico, Canada, Germany, the United Kingdom, Eastern Europe, China, Australia, South Korea, and India. Linde plc was founded in 1879 and is based in Woking, the United Kingdom.
